title: 第一百零八章 沙与花
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

韩长老，不，韩立，看着面前那堆金色的沙砾。

沙砾很细，很均匀，在溶洞阴冷的风里，微微地颤动着，像是某种有生命的东西，在艰难地呼吸。

他抬起自己那只刚刚恢复知觉的手，指尖还在不受控制地颤抖。他摸了摸自己的胸口，那里，那块曾经坚硬如铁的、由怨气和尸气凝结而成的“尸心”，不见了。取而代之的，是一个血肉模糊的、还在隐隐作痛的伤口。

伤口很深，几乎贯穿了他的胸膛。

但，是活的。

他能感觉到，一股微弱的、温热的血流，正在伤口周围缓缓流淌。这感觉，陌生得让他想哭，又让他想吐。

他死了太久，早就忘了“活”是什么滋味。

他抬起头，看向溶洞深处。林秋和王虎正从地上爬起来，踉踉跄跄地走过来。他们看到韩立还站在那里，没有攻击的意图，这才松了一口气，但眼神里依旧充满了警惕和恐惧。

毕竟，这个人是韩长老。是那个把他们打入死牢，判了陈默死刑的人。

韩立没有看他们。他的目光，死死地钉在那堆沙砾上。

他想起了很多。

想起在青云宗的大殿上，陈默跪在下面，眼神倔强，像一块砸不烂的石头。

想起在死牢里，他为了逼问柴刀的秘密，用尽了酷刑，而陈默从头到尾，没发出一声求饶。

想起最后，那只覆盖着金属鳞片的手掌，穿透了他的身体，吞噬了他的灵魂。

那时候，他是多么恨陈默。

恨他的不识时务，恨他的冥顽不灵，恨他把自己也拖进了这万劫不复的深渊。

可现在……

韩立缓缓地蹲下身，伸出颤抖的手指，轻轻触碰了一下那堆沙砾。

冰凉，坚硬，没有一丝温度。

这就是陈默。

那个曾经在他面前，连头都不敢抬的杂役弟子。

那个被他视为蝼蚁，随时可以碾碎的陈默。

最后，却用这种方式，把他从永恒的黑暗里，拉了回来。

韩立的喉咙里，发出一声压抑的、如同野兽哀鸣般的哽咽。

他猛地抓起一把沙砾，死死地攥在手里，用力到指节发白，指甲嵌入掌心，渗出血来。

“你……”他的声音嘶哑，破碎，“你这蠢货……”

“你为什么要这么做？”

“你知不知道，我根本不值得你救？”

“你知不知道，我死了，才是最好的解脱！”

他对着那堆沙砾，嘶吼着，咆哮着。声音在空旷的溶洞里，回荡，撞击，最后消散在死寂的黑暗里。

沙砾，在他的掌心，静静地躺着。

没有回答。

林秋走到韩立身边，看着他颤抖的背影，看着他手里那把金色的沙，眼泪又流了下来。

她没有说话，只是默默地，从地上，捡起了一朵花。

那是之前在废墟上，从金尸眉心掉落的那朵白色小花。它居然跟着他们，一路来到了这里，花瓣已经有些蔫了，但依旧顽强地开着。

林秋把小花，轻轻地，放在了那堆沙砾旁边。

韩立看着那朵花，身体猛地一震。

他想起在很久以前，在他还不是韩长老的时候，在他还是个外门小修士的时候，他也曾给一个喜欢的师妹，送过一朵这样的野花。

那时候，天很蓝，花很香，人心也很简单。

他猛地转过身，不再看那堆沙砾，不再看那朵花。

他站起身，背对着林秋和王虎，那干枯的、青黑色的脊背，挺得笔直。

“走。”

一个字，冰冷，生硬，听不出任何情绪。

林秋和王虎愣了一下。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Elder Han, no, Han Li, looked at the pile of golden gravel in front of him.

The gravel was very fine and even, trembling slightly in the cold wind of the cave, as if something alive was breathing hard.

He raised his hand that had just regained consciousness, his fingertips still trembling uncontrollably.He touched his chest. The "corpse heart" that was once as hard as iron and was condensed from resentment and corpse energy was gone.Instead, there was a bloody and still painful wound.

The wound was deep, almost running through his chest.

But, it is alive.

He could feel a weak, warm blood flowing slowly around the wound.This feeling was so unfamiliar that it made him want to cry and vomit.

He has been dead for so long that he has long forgotten what "living" feels like.

He raised his head and looked into the depths of the cave.Lin Qiu and Wang Hu were getting up from the ground and staggering over.They were relieved when they saw that Han Li was still standing there with no intention of attacking, but their eyes were still full of vigilance and fear.

After all, this person is Elder Han.He was the one who put them on death row and sentenced Chen Mo to death.

Han Li didn't look at them.His eyes were fixed on the pile of gravel.

He remembered a lot.

I remembered that in the main hall of Qingyun Sect, Chen Mo was kneeling below, his eyes stubborn, like an unbreakable stone.

He remembered that in death row, he had used all kinds of torture in order to extract the secret of Hatchet, but Chen Mo never uttered a word of begging for mercy from the beginning to the end.

Thinking of the last moment, the palm covered with metal scales penetrated his body and swallowed his soul.

At that time, he hated Chen Mo so much.

I hate him for not knowing the current affairs, I hate him for being stubborn, I hate him for dragging me into this abyss of eternal destruction.

But now...

Han Li slowly knelt down, stretched out his trembling fingers, and lightly touched the pile of gravel.

Cold, hard, without any warmth.

This is Chen Mo.

The handyman disciple who once stood in front of him and didn't even dare to raise his head.

Chen Mo, whom he regarded as an ant, could be crushed at any time.

In the end, he used this method to pull him back from the eternal darkness.

A suppressed sob sounded from Han Li's throat, like the wail of a beast.

He suddenly grabbed a handful of gravel and held it tightly in his hand, so hard that his knuckles turned white and his nails dug into his palms, bleeding.

"You..." His voice was hoarse and broken, "You idiot..."

"Why are you doing this?"

"Do you know that I'm not worth saving?"

"Do you know that the best relief is for me to die?"

He roared and roared at the pile of gravel.The sound echoed and collided in the empty cave, and finally dissipated into the dead darkness.

The gravel lay quietly in his palm.

No answer.

Lin Qiu walked up to Han Li, looked at his trembling back, looked at the golden sand in his hand, and shed tears again.

She didn't speak, just silently picked up a flower from the ground.

That was the small white flower that fell from the forehead of the golden corpse on the ruins.It actually followed them all the way here. The petals were already a little wilted, but they were still blooming tenaciously.

Lin Qiu gently placed the little flower next to the pile of gravel.

Han Li looked at the flower and his body shook violently.

He remembered that a long time ago, when he was not Elder Han, when he was still a young outer monk, he had given such a wild flower to a junior sister he liked.

At that time, the sky was blue, the flowers were fragrant, and people's hearts were simple.

He turned around suddenly, no longer looking at the pile of gravel or the flower.

He stood up and turned his back to Lin Qiu and Wang Hu. His dry, blue-black back was straight.

"Let's go."

One word, cold, stiff, without any emotion.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu were stunned for a moment.
